title: Latest-per-run outcome summary
failure_mode: User outcomes are not model accuracy

context.question: Statically review the selected evidence. Separate supported observations from unverified outcomes and propose focused checks.

findings.statement: The summary assigns each accepted record to latest by run_id, so a later accepted record replaces an earlier accepted record for that run.
findings.rationale: The assignment occurs while iterating the file lines.

findings.statement: The returned resolution fraction is an automated quality score for all users.
findings.rationale: The note limits the fraction to user labels on reviewed first contacts and explicitly excludes an automated score.

next_steps.proposal: Propose a fixture with two accepted records for one run to check which outcome enters the summary.
next_steps.rationale: This tests the visible replacement mechanism and makes no executed-result claim.
